tasks.title: Unbox and widen
tasks.prompt: Return the value of the Integer boxed as a double (unbox, then widen).

tasks.title: Average as double
tasks.prompt: Return the average of two ints as a double, with no loss of precision (avoid integer division).

tasks.title: Count vowels
tasks.prompt: Return the number of vowels (a, e, i, o, u, case-insensitive) in s.

tasks.title: Reverse each word
tasks.prompt: Return the sentence with each whitespace-separated word reversed, words kept in order.

tasks.title: Collapse whitespace
tasks.prompt: Trim s and replace every run of whitespace with a single space. Return the normalized string.

tasks.title: Fizz value
tasks.prompt: Return "Fizz" if n % 3 == 0, "Buzz" if n % 5 == 0, "FizzBuzz" if both, else the number as a String.

tasks.title: Letter grade (switch expression)
tasks.prompt: Using a switch EXPRESSION on the tens digit of score (0..100), return A (90+), B (80+), C (70+), D (60+), else F. Use arrow labels and yield inside a block for one arm.

tasks.title: Record with validation
tasks.prompt: Define a record Point(int x, int y) whose compact constructor clamps negative values to 0. The harness prints p.x() and p.y().

tasks.title: Enum with a field and method
tasks.prompt: Define enum Size { SMALL(1), LARGE(10) } with an int factor field and a method int scaled(int n) returning n * factor. The harness prints Size.LARGE.scaled(3).

tasks.title: Polymorphic speak
tasks.prompt: Define class Animal with String speak() returning "..." and class Dog extends Animal overriding speak() to return "Woof". The harness calls speak on an Animal reference holding a Dog.

tasks.title: Custom checked exception
tasks.prompt: Define a checked exception class NegativeException (extends Exception) with a message constructor. Then write `static int sqrtish(int n)` that throws NegativeException with message "neg" when n < 0 and returns n otherwise. The harness catches it.

tasks.title: AutoCloseable resource
tasks.prompt: Res is an AutoCloseable that should append its name to the static log when closed. Complete close() and use() so use() opens Res("a") then Res("b") in try-with-resources and returns the log.

tasks.title: Dedupe keeping order
tasks.prompt: Return a new int[] with duplicates removed, preserving first-seen order.

tasks.title: Word frequency (merge)
tasks.prompt: Return a Map<String,Integer> counting each word in the array, using Map.merge.

tasks.title: Write and read a file
tasks.prompt: Write the given text to the file named by path (using Files), then read it back and return it.

tasks.title: Serialize and deserialize
tasks.prompt: Class Box implements Serializable with int v and transient int hidden. Write static int hiddenAfterRoundTrip() that writes a Box(v=5, hidden=9) to a file, reads it back, and returns the restored hidden field.

tasks.title: Squares of evens
tasks.prompt: Return the sum of the squares of the even numbers in the list, using a stream pipeline.

tasks.title: Group by length and count
tasks.prompt: Return a Map<Integer,Long> counting words by their length, using Collectors.groupingBy with a downstream counting collector.

tasks.title: Filter, uppercase, join
tasks.prompt: Return a comma-separated string of the words longer than 1 character, uppercased, in order.

tasks.title: Atomic counter across threads
tasks.prompt: Increment an AtomicInteger n times total using two threads (each doing n/2 increments via getAndIncrement), join them, and return the final value. Assume n is even.

tasks.title: Future sum
tasks.prompt: Using an ExecutorService, submit a Callable that returns the sum of 1..n, get the result from the Future, shut down, and return it.

tasks.title: Days between two dates
tasks.prompt: Return the number of whole days from the ISO date a to the ISO date b using ChronoUnit.

tasks.title: Format a date
tasks.prompt: Parse the ISO date string and format it as dd/MM/yyyy using a DateTimeFormatter.

tasks.title: Compact source with IO
tasks.prompt: Write a compact source file (no class, no imports) whose instance main prints the size of List.of(1,2,3) using IO.

tasks.title: Instance main reads a field
tasks.prompt: Write a compact source file with an instance field n = 7 and an instance main that prints n.

tasks.title: Format a message
tasks.prompt: Using MessageFormat, return the pattern "Hello {0}, you owe {1}." filled with name and amount.

tasks.title: Parse a formatted number
tasks.prompt: Use NumberFormat for Locale.US to parse the given string and return its int value.
